rules: The hook is the first 1-3 seconds: open on the most surprising, concrete or tense thing in THIS content. No greeting, intro or setup (never 'Xin chào', 'Hôm nay mình sẽ chia sẻ', 'Trong thời đại').
Specific beats vague: name the real object, person, action, place, tool or number from the evidence instead of 'điều này', 'thứ này', 'sản phẩm này'.

Use one mechanism: curiosity gap / open loop, contrarian or myth-bust, mistake or warning, direct callout of who it is for ('Nếu bạn...'), pointed question, result first, or start in the middle of the action.
The content must pay the hook off: only open a loop the content really closes. No clickbait lies, no promise, result, price, secret or experience the evidence does not show.

Adapt a pattern's STRUCTURE to the real content. Never copy a template line verbatim. Patterns marked CLAIM assert numbers, results, prices, tests or personal experience: use them only when the evidence states that exact claim, with its real figure.
At most 10 words (hard limit 12) so it fits a text overlay; natural spoken Vietnamese that sounds said aloud in one breath; no hashtags, emoji or quotation marks.
Avoid AI cliches: đột phá, nâng tầm, mở khóa, hé lộ, thần thánh, đỉnh cao, không thể tin nổi, bí mật động trời.
The words must match what is seen and heard in the first seconds.
scoring: Write exactly 3 different candidates, each built on a different pattern id from the list. Score each 1-5 for curiosity (makes the viewer need the next second), specificity (concrete real detail), truthfulness (every word supported by the evidence; 5 = fully supported) and fit (matches the content type and the opening visual). Choose the candidate with the highest total among those with truthfulness 5.
